entries.summary: SaveAsync now reports failure; MaxLogDays is wired to Serilog; settings exposes SmartRisk exclusions.
Exclusions flow into ScanContext; developer artifacts and low-signal scripts are filtered or downgraded while content evidence remains high signal.
Process identity includes start time; exited-only cleanup and event debouncing remove PID reuse and process storm behavior.
Startup checks only; download/apply require user action; apply confirms interruption of active scans.
Configured startup update runs only when signatures are older than 24 hours and Defender is available.
User-facing update and privacy claims now match the implemented behavior.
Verified publish.ps1 under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7 parsing, then ran the full build-test-package pipeline with Inno Setup 6.7.3; local artifacts and hashes matched.
Confirmed the remote exposes only main, restored the local main ref to origin/main, and configured main to track and push to origin/main. No unrelated branches remained to delete.
